related.title: ALiBi：距離偏置與注意力衰減
related.titleEn: ALiBi: distance bias and attention decay
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付旋轉矩陣、範數表與相對角不變性測試。；內積.8660254與.5符合，範數1且共同角移不改內積。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver rotations, norm tables and relative-angle invariance tests.; Dot products match, norms remain1 and common angle shifts preserve the dot product.
related.difference: 列query位置20與key20、12、4，距離0、8、16；未來key仍需因果遮罩。；偏置−1、−2正確，共同平移不變且未來key機率0。
related.differenceEn: List query20 and keys20,12,4, distances0,8,16; future keys still require a causal mask.; Biases−1 and−2 match, common shifts preserve them and future-key probability is zero.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 二維單位向量分別旋轉θq、θk，其內積cos(θq−θk)；旋轉保持範數。；教學θq=π/3、θk=π/6；再令θk=0。；s=cos(π/6)=.8660254；改後cos(π/3)=.5。
因果距離d≥0的偏置b=−md；不同head可有不同m，分數仍需softmax。；教學m=.125,d=8；改d16。；b=−.125×8=−1；d16時−2。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unit vectors rotated by θq and θk have dot product cos(θq−θk); rotations preserve norms.; Teaching θq=π/3,θk=π/6, then θk=0.; s=cos(π/6)=.8660254; changed score cos(π/3)=.5.
For causal distance d≥0, bias b=−md; heads may use different slopes and still require softmax.; Teaching slope.125,distance8, then16.; b=−.125×8=−1; d16 gives−2.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.differenceEn: Tabulate per-step alpha and cumulative alpha-bar, draw signal/noise branches and record the noise seed.; Results match, squared signal/noise coefficients sum1 and seeds reproduce outputs.
